title: Clipboard action selection could be easier/quicker
line: Every command in the clipboard's action popup now has an underlined letter, so one key press runs it.
explanation: Klipper's action popup is a QMenu whose command entries use the command description as plain text, so only Cancel ("&Cancel") had an accelerator and reaching the Nth command took N arrow presses. The change calls KAcceleratorManager::manage() on the menu after filling it, which gives every command a unique underlined letter (pressing it runs the command, with or without Alt) and keeps any '&' mnemonic the user wrote in a description when it doesn't clash.

commits.message:
klipper: give action popup commands keyboard accelerators

The action popup only gave Cancel an accelerator, so reaching a command
from the keyboard took one arrow press per entry. Let KAcceleratorManager
assign a letter to each command, keeping any the user set with "&".

BUG: 526838

media.caption: Master, action with 10 commands: only Cancel has an accelerator; pressing M does nothing
With the fix every command has its own letter; pressing M runs Make QR Code
